hypothesis: Names-first discovery followed by exact retrieval of the required web-search connector reduces serialized registry payload by at least 90 percent without losing the capability or primary-source research quality.
limitations: One sequential web-research task and one registry snapshot. The broad baseline exactly follows the predeclared expression but may overmatch. The intervention includes both discovery passes and retained the one required operation; research quality was checked against three official primary sources. Bytes are not tokens, and no latency, cache, model-choice accuracy or downstream task-success effect was measured.
